instrumentation: Real pointer/button/keyboard input in an isolated project. Feedback ends at RAF observation of the requested DOM state. Interactive terminal additionally waits for the matching final geometry, enabled Undo, original CSS motion, and group transition cleanup. The product retains 420ms motion and 620ms transition lifecycle. CDP script/layout duration distinguishes main-thread work from animation wall time; compositor presentation delay is outside this measurement. Screenshots and HTTP state/source assertions run outside timed phases. Same immutable source annotation is asserted after each operation. Internal note editing uses native keyboard input and blur save. Objects are created sequentially with fixed IDs, creation order, asset names and asserted initial geometry; every gesture addresses an explicit target ID.
semanticStatePrecision: Cross-round comparison omits random immutable asset IDs, checks source asset names/content and member/group IDs, and rounds world coordinates to 6 decimal places. Within each run Undo/Redo API shapes are checked exactly; DOM CSS pose matching uses 0.01 world pixel to account for CSS numeric serialization.
notes: The calibration driver first timed out after a successful internal move: persisted x313.333333... was serialized by CSS as313.333px and exceeded the initial0.0001 threshold. The corrected DOM threshold is0.01 world pixel, and exact service/Undo assertions remain. No product change was made for this fixture issue.

All timed runs preserve the original420ms motion and620ms lifecycle. First feedback and interactive terminal are reported separately, and terminal includes original CSS/hover animations. Drag first response starts at pointerdown; CDP action durations also include Alt/locator positioning and action completion overhead.
Every measured drag records one pointerdown,30 moves with buttons,one pointerup,and final DOM/API pose. The harness does not assert that each intermediate move was presented.
Long tasks are assigned by their startTime within the measured phase. Source/state/content checks and screenshots run outside timed phases.
The source annotation remains byte-for-byte structurally identical within each run, including its target, sceneSource and capture. Cross-round annotations have independent service-issued IDs.

Folder drag pointerdown-to-feedback averages47.6ms baseline and66.0ms candidate. The recorded second move, which first crosses the3px threshold, arrives31.2/31.5ms after down in baseline and48.7/49.8ms in candidate. Threshold-crossing move-to-feedback is15.5/17.0ms baseline and16.8/16.7ms candidate. The wall-clock difference therefore includes a recorded extra input-delivery frame; both measures remain visible. RAF gaps during these drags remain approximately16.7ms.
